strategy.name: walk
strategy.reason: All 499 trials were read and grouped here.

interpretation.chart_rationale: Rule 12: two different kinds of node, so a bipartite network.

plan.interpretation: Link sponsors to drugs across Duchenne muscular dystrophy trials.

assumptions: Read 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' as a condition: 12 trials have it in an intervention name and 462 in a condition. Matched 'Duchenne muscular dystrophy' with the registry's condition search (conditions, titles, keywords and MeSH terms, with synonyms): 499 trials.
Sponsors are the lead sponsor's name as registered; variants of one name are not merged.
Drug names are normalised from free text: doses and forms are removed, placebos and non-drug care are left out, and a combination is split only when each part is a known drug.
A sponsor and a drug are linked when one trial lists both. The sponsor of a trial is its lead sponsor.

warnings.message: Drug names are free text and only partly normalised: one compound under a code name and a generic name can appear as two entries.

items.rule: The 15 largest per side, by trials, that have a link.
Links of at least 2 trials, the 60 heaviest.

citations.selection: trials naming the searched entity first, then most recently first-posted, then by NCT ID

trace.summary: Link sponsors to drugs across Duchenne muscular dystrophy trials.
